arc sample

  • CURIE: gmeow:arcSample
  • IRI: https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/arcSample
  • Category: property
  • Defined by: gmeow:slices/narrative

Attaches a sample to its integrating CharacterArc (⊑ gmeow:hasPart — samples are parts of the arc's analysis). Purely ADDITIVE to the existing CharacterArc: arcType and arcEvidence remain the holistic interpretive layer, and an arc with no samples stays valid. NOT functional.

Structure

Property shape: object property; gmeow:CharacterArc -> gmeow:ArcSample Sub-property of: gmeow:hasPart

Practical Pattern

Use gmeow:arcSample from gmeow:CharacterArc to gmeow:ArcSample when the relationship itself belongs in the native GMEOW graph.

Common Companion Terms

gmeow:hasPart, gmeow:CharacterArc, gmeow:ArcSample
